title: HR Operations Advisor
description:
**Overview**
 At Quest Software, we build technology that simplifies IT management and strengthens cybersecurity resilience for organizations around the world.
   

  

 Our people are central to our success, and we are committed to delivering an HR experience that reflects our global footprint, growth mindset, and employee\-first culture .
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Quest Software is seeking an HR Operations Advisor, based in India, to serve as an advanced, globally connected subject\-matter expert within our HR Operations function, with a strong anchor in our growing APJ population. While this role is based in India, it is global in scope and mindset — we are looking for a seasoned operator who works beyond regional boundaries, brings deep functional expertise, and helps shape how HR Operations runs enterprise\-wide.
   

  

 This is an advanced individual\-contributor role for someone who owns the most complex work in the function. You will resolve ambiguous, high\-impact cases that lack clear precedent, determine methods and procedures on new assignments, and guide the development of new policies and processes. You will act as a trusted advisor to HR Business Partners and global HR Operations colleagues, mentor less\-experienced team members, and be accountable through the team for tactical business outcomes — while supporting the systems that underpin our service delivery, including Dayforce and HR ServiceNow.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

 Advanced Operational Delivery \& Complex Case Resolution
   

  

* Own the most complex, ambiguous, and high\-impact cases across the employee lifecycle — onboarding and offboarding, employee changes, data management, immigration, leaves of absence, and compliance — where solutions are not clearly defined and require in\-depth evaluation of variable factors.
* Manage escalated HR ServiceNow cases end to end, exercising independent judgment to resolve issues that fall outside standard procedure and setting the standard for quality and responsiveness.
* Serve as an advanced regional expert for APJ while championing a “one HR Operations team” approach across all geographies.


 Policy, Process \& Standards Development
   

  

* Guide the development of new policies, procedures, and repeatable processes — directing the application of existing principles and shaping how the global function operates.
* Determine methods and procedures on new assignments and initiatives, adapting complex techniques and evaluation criteria to deliver results consistent with departmental objectives.
* Lead standardization and automation efforts that scale across regions, partnering with HRIS, Payroll, and IT to strengthen data integrity and system workflows in Dayforce.


 Trusted Advisor \& Cross\-Functional Influence
   

  

* Advise HR Business Partners, managers, and global HR Operations colleagues on complex matters, adapting style and using persuasion to deliver messages that relate to the wider business.
* Network with key contacts outside your own area of expertise — including Finance, Legal, and Payroll — to drive accurate, compliant, and aligned employee administration.
* Act as an informal team leader: mentor and up\-skill less\-experienced colleagues and raise the capability of the broader team.


 Global Alignment, Projects \& Scaling
   

  

* Take a leading role in HR projects and initiatives — including system changes, implementations, and vendor transitions — accountable through the team for delivery of tactical business targets.
* Contribute to the long\-term design of global HR Operations standards, documentation, and governance as the organization continues to scale.


**Qualifications**
**Why This Role**
 This role is the senior operational anchor of a global HR Operations team. You will take on the work that most shapes our function — solving the hardest problems, guiding new policy and process, and advising partners across the business — while mentoring the next generation of operators and supporting the continued growth of our APJ and worldwide employee population.
   

  

**We Are Looking For**
* A minimum of 8 years of related HR Operations or HR Shared Services experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 6 years with a Master’s degree; or equivalent experience.
* Advanced, wide\-ranging expertise across the HR Operations discipline, with a proven ability to resolve complex problems that lack clear precedent and to determine methods on new assignments.
* Experience operating within a global HR function, with strong cross\-regional influence across EMEA, U.S., and/or APJ, and an understanding of how HR Operations interrelates with adjacent disciplines.
* Hands\-on experience with HR systems — Dayforce and ServiceNow preferred — and exemplary data accuracy and confidentiality practices.
* Demonstrated ability to advise others on complex matters, influence without direct authority, and mentor or informally lead team members.
* Strong stakeholder management and persuasive communication skills in English across distributed teams and time zones.


 At Quest, your work makes an impact. You’ll help organizations get AI\-ready while building your career with a truly global team of high\-performing, passionate innovators.

**Job Description**
 Individual will be part of the Payroll and HR Shared Services function within the CPO organization, responsible for managing end\-to\-end payroll operations and employee service delivery. The role includes overseeing payroll processing, taxation, statutory compliance, full\-and\-final settlements, internal and external audits, responses to statutory notices and inspections, year\-end payroll activities, investment proof validation, and Form 16 generation and distribution, while ensuring accuracy, compliance, strong governance, and an exceptional employee experience.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Manage end\-to\-end payroll operations, including payroll inputs, validation, processing, reconciliation, disbursement, post\-payroll activities, and full\-and\-final settlements, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for payroll and HR Shared Services\-related queries, ensuring prompt resolution of employee and stakeholder concerns while delivering an exceptional employee experience.
* Partner with payroll vendors and internal stakeholders to ensure seamless service delivery, strong governance, and adherence to established service levels and controls.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across Payroll and HR Shared Services processes to enhance efficiency, accuracy, compliance, and customer satisfaction.
* Oversee taxation, statutory compliance, year\-end activities, Form 16 generation and distribution, investment proof validation, and responses to statutory notices, audits, and inspections.
* Develop, generate, and analyze payroll, HRSS, and operational reports using tools such as Excel, Workday, and other reporting platforms to support business decision\-making.
* Create dashboards and management reporting that provide insights into payroll operations, service delivery performance, employee experience, compliance, and operational metrics.
* Lead automation and process simplification initiatives, including report centralization, workflow optimization, self\-service enablement, and digitization efforts.
* Manage escalations effectively, identify root causes, and implement sustainable solutions to improve service quality and process effectiveness.
* Support and implement recommendations arising from payroll audits, control reviews, risk assessments, and compliance evaluations.
* Manage payroll accounting activities, including preparation, validation, and timely posting of payroll journal entries to the general ledger.
* Perform payroll\-to\-general ledger and balance sheet reconciliations, investigate variances, and ensure timely resolution of exceptions and aged items.
* Coordinate payroll accruals, provisions, reversals, and month\-end and year\-end financial activities close in line with established controls and timelines.
* Partner closely with Finance, Accounting, Tax, Compliance, HR, and payroll vendors to ensure accurate payroll processing, reporting, funding, and accounting treatment.
* Maintain audit\-ready documentation, support internal and external audits, and ensure adherence to regulatory, financial, and operational control requirements.
* Monitor changes in labor laws, payroll regulations, and taxation requirements, and drive the implementation of required process, policy, and system updates.
* Establish and monitor service delivery metrics, key performance indicators (KPIs), and service level agreements (SLAs) to ensure operational excellence within HR Shared Services.
* Lead, coach, and develop team members while fostering a culture of accountability, customer focus, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
* Support HR Shared Services transformation initiatives, including process standardization, centralization, employee self\-service adoption, and digital\-first service delivery models.


**Requirements**
**Mandatory skills:**
* Academic qualification – Postgraduate (preferable), CA/CWA (Optional)
* Working knowledge of Account Reconciliations
* Working knowledge of payroll accounting, journal entries, general ledger accounting, accruals and month\-end close activities.
* Ability to analyze and resolve payroll\-to\-general\-ledger reconciliation differences and aged open items.
* Candidates must have excellent communication, analytical abilities, written/oral communication skills
* Should have excellent MS Excel and MS office skills.
* Ability to produce/analyze statistical reports and produce Excel spreadsheets
* Ability to act on own initiative and meet deadlines.
* Ability to adhere to confidentiality requirements.
* Ability to work with little supervision, using own initiative and able to manage sub\-teams
* Sound multi\-tasking and organizational skills, with the ability to work effectively in a complex and dynamic environment.
* Experience in medium/large reputed organization in financial services/technology space would be preferred along with working knowledge of key Payroll (and HR) software packages
* Experience with face\-to\-face people issues – good customer service ethic.
* Able to analyze and follow policies and procedures in service delivery.


**Desired Skills**
* Certifications in Payroll / Statutory Compliances etc. would be an added advantage.
* Strong and relevant experience in statistical analysis concepts
* Excellent innovative ideas which can help team to deliver more efficient ways
* Should have strong HR experience of at least 12\-14 years
* Must have experience in managing Payroll.
* Must have knowledge on various applicable labor laws and Taxation laws related to payroll.
* Must have exposure of handling Full \& Final Settlements process.
* Ability to reconcile pay runs and end of year reports.
* Exposure to payroll accounting controls, balance sheet substantiation and audit documentation would be preferred.
* Working knowledge of appropriate legislative and regulatory requirements.

title: System Expert VNDLY
description:

Support contingent workforce reporting and analytics, including headcount, spend, vendor performance, and compliance metrics. Ensure reporting and dashboards are accurate, timely, and aligned with business needs. Strong knowledge of external workforce lifecycle and HR processes. Experience with HR system integrations, with Workday integration expertise preferred. Experience with AMS support models (L2/L3\). Ability to translate business requirements into system solutions. Strong collaboration skills across HR, Procurement, Finance, and IT stakeholders.  This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed \- both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end\-to\-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!
   

  

 You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy \- and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.
   

  

* Roles with real accountability and visible impact
* Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
* Continuous learning and development as the business grows
* Reward linked to performance and contribution.


 Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.

title: Change Analyst
description:

 We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 As a Change Analyst, you will partner with the GIC Change Lead to support transformation initiatives from a change management lens. You will help bring structure, clarity, and follow\-through to complex change by translating business and project needs into practical change approaches that drive adoption and measurable outcomes. You will also leverage reusable enterprise assets, tools, and practices that help make change more consistent and effective over time.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
**Support Transformation Initiatives**
* Partner with the GIC Change Lead to support transformation initiatives through a structured change management lens.
* Support the design and execution of change strategies, plans, and activities that drive adoption and sustain business outcomes.
* Translate business and project requirements into practical change interventions, including development of the change narrative, stakeholder analysis, change plans, and supporting resources.
* Leverage GMI’s Change Playbook, tools, templates, and reusable assets to promote consistent and effective change practices across GIC initiatives.


**Evaluate Change Impact and Readiness**
* Assess and organize change impacts across initiatives, stakeholder groups, and ways of working.
* Manage change impact data and reporting through the change dashboard to support visibility, tracking, and decision\-making.
* Evaluate organizational readiness and help shape approaches that enable effective adoption of change.


**Collaborate with Project Teams**
* Coordinate with project teams, business stakeholders, and functional partners to gather inputs, align on priorities, and support execution of change activities.
* Partner with Learning and Development, Communications, Project Managers, and business leaders to activate engagement plans and drive adoption actions.
* Support the execution of change activities with a focus on quality, consistency, and business relevance.


**Sustain the rigor through continuous learning and feedback**
* Capture lessons learned and stakeholder feedback throughout initiatives, and apply insights to refine approaches and lead change with agility.
* Identify recurring themes, risks, and opportunities across the GIC change portfolio and escalate relevant insights to the Change Lead.
* Provide feedback to the CoE to support ongoing improvement of change methodologies, tools, and practices.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in change management, business, communications, human resources, organizational psychology, or a related field.
* 2 to 4 years of experience supporting change management work on transformation, process improvement, or organizational change initiatives.
* Experience supporting core change management deliverables
* Ability to work effectively with cross\-functional stakeholders at multiple levels to gather inputs, support alignment, and help execute change activities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize information into clear, concise, leadership\-ready updates/presentations.
* Strong organizational and project coordination skills, including the ability to navigate the organization and manage multiple priorities with attention to detail and follow\-through.


**Preferred Qualifications**
 Up to 7 years of experience supporting change management work on large\-scale, cross\-functional transformation initiatives in complex stakeholder environments.
   

  

* Consulting experience in change management, transformation, and/or program delivery, with the ability to:
* bring structure to ambiguity
* synthesize inputs
* turn insights into actionable recommendations
* Experience supporting change intake, prioritization, tiering, and governance processes, including maintaining intake artifacts and preparing decision\-support materials.
* Experience facilitating:
* working sessions
* stakeholder discussions
* change enablement activities
* Experience leveraging reusable change assets – including playbooks, templates, tools, and reporting materials – to drive consistency, while applying the art of of change through judgement, adaptation and continuous improvement
* Change management certification, education, or formal training such as Prosci.


**ELIGIBILITY**
 Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

 90648**

**Join us as a**
 Sr. Manager \- Human Resources
   

  

**Your Main Responsibilities**
**Role Summary:**
 Drive an inclusive, respectful, and values\-led workplace culture by embedding diversity, equity, inclusion, ethical conduct, employee voice mechanisms, and statutory compliance frameworks across the organization.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**
* Inclusion and Diversity


 Design and implement initiatives that foster an inclusive, equitable, and respectful workplace.
   

  

 Partner with HR Business Partners and business leaders to integrate inclusion principles into relevant work \& HR processes.
   

  

 Monitor diversity metrics, identify gaps, and recommend action plans to improve representation and inclusion outcomes.
   

  

 Lead employee resource groups (ERGs) and inclusion champions networks.
   

  

 Drive awareness campaigns, observance of diversity calendars, and organization\-wide inclusion programs.
   

  

 Measure employee sentiment on inclusion and belonging through surveys, focus groups, and other feedback mechanisms.
   

  

* Culture Transformation, Employee Experience and Employer Branding


 Champion the organization's values and translate them into tangible employee behaviors and practices.
   

  

 Design and implement culture\-building interventions that strengthen employee engagement and organizational effectiveness.
   

  

 Partner with leaders to enhance culture, team effectiveness, collaboration, and psychological safety.
   

  

 Analyze employee feedback and engagement data to identify cultural strengths, risks, and improvement opportunities.
   

  

 Develop and implement action plans to improve employee experience and workplace culture.
   

  

 Act as a trusted advisor to leaders on culture\-related challenges and change management initiatives.
   

  

 Manage the organization's employer brand presence across external platforms including LinkedIn, Glassdoor, Ambition Box, Indeed, and other relevant channels.
   

  

 Monitor employer brand metrics, candidate feedback, and external reputation indicators, recommending actions to strengthen the organization's position as an employer of choice.
   

  

 Drive participation in employer branding awards, external benchmarking studies, and best workplace certifications to enhance organizational visibility and market reputation.
   

  

* Employee Grievance Management


 Own and manage the organization's grievance redressal framework and mechanisms.
   

  

 Review, investigate, and resolve employee complaints in a fair, confidential, and timely manner.
   

  

 Conduct fact\-finding investigations and recommend appropriate resolutions based on policy and organizational values.
   

  

 Track grievance trends, identify systemic issues, and recommend preventive interventions.
   

  

 Partner with HR, Legal, and business leaders to ensure consistency and fairness in grievance resolution.
   

  

 Maintain confidential records and documentation in line with legal and organizational requirements.
   

  

 Build employee confidence in speaking\-up and escalation mechanisms.
   

  

* Ethics \& Ant\-discrimination


 Lead ethics communication, training, and awareness programs for employees and managers.
   

  

 Manage ethics\-related complaints, conduct investigations, and coordinate resolution processes.
   

  

 Monitor ethics trends and recommend actions to strengthen ethical culture and risk mitigation.
   

  

* POSH (Prevention of Sexual Harassment) Compliance


 Serve as the HR custodian for POSH compliance in line with applicable legislation.
   

  

 Support and coordinate the Internal Committee (IC) and ensure effective case management.
   

  

 Ensure timely and compliant handling of POSH complaints, investigations, and documentation.
   

  

 Facilitate POSH awareness, sensitization, and certification programs across employee groups.
   

  

 Maintain all statutory records and ensure compliance with annual reporting requirements.
   

  

 Review organizational practices and recommend improvements to strengthen workplace safety and respect.
   

  

 Provide guidance to managers and employees on POSH\-related concerns while maintaining confidentiality and procedural fairness.
   

  

* Governance, Analytics \& Reporting


 Develop dashboards and reports on inclusion, culture, grievances, ethics, and POSH metrics.
   

  

 Track key indicators such as diversity metrics, grievance resolution timelines and ethics cases, I\&D compliance module completions.
   

  

 Present insights and recommendations to HR leadership and senior management.
   

  

 Benchmark external best practices and recommend enhancements to organizational programs.
   

  

**What You Bring**

**Qualification:**
 Master’s degree in human resources, Organizational Psychology, Business Administration, Social Sciences, or a related field.
   

  

 Certification or specialized training in Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion (DEI), Employee Relations, POSH, Ethics \& Compliance, or Employee Experience would be preferred.
   

  

 Certified POSH Trainer/Investigator or experience supporting Internal Committees will be an added advantage.
   

  

**Professional Experience:**
 8\+ years of progressive HR experience, with significant exposure to Inclusion \& Diversity, Culture Transformation, Employee Experience, Employee Relations, and Compliance.
   

  

 Proven experience in designing and implementing DEI, culture, engagement, and employer branding initiatives.
   

  

 Demonstrated experience in handling employee grievances, workplace investigations, ethics cases, and sensitive employee relations matters.
   

  

 Strong understanding of POSH legislation and practical experience supporting complaint management, investigations, and compliance reporting.
   

  

**Skills Required for the Job:**
 Excellent stakeholder management, communication, influencing, facilitation, and conflict resolution skills.
   

  

 Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate employee insights into actionable interventions.
   

  

 High levels of integrity, empathy, and judgment, with the ability to drive a culture of trust, inclusion, accountability, and compliance.

* Your development matters to us. We help you grow by offering the support you need to develop your skills and access a rewarding and fulfilling career.
* Thrive in a diverse and supportive culture. Through local and global initiatives, we promote a culture of inclusion which celebrates diversity and ensures that everyone feels valued.


**We Elevate… Your Career**
